back: What the system does: a feature or behaviour a user can observe.
How well the system does it: performance, reliability, security, maintainability and so on.
Thread safety, extensibility, testability, input validation and core-operation performance.
It is measurable and tied to a specific operation, for example p95 under 200 ms.
A constraint is a fixed decision you must accept, like a language version or an existing API.
